% tab_grid, note. Generated by paper-v4/tools/make_tables.py; do not edit.
Each chip ran one query of the repeated-alphabet sequence with multi-query \texttt{pmap}, all eight chips were visible, and the timed region was \texttt{apply}. Each point ran once. The extra time is the steady-state call on eight chips minus the call on one chip, both derived from the recorded throughputs. The summary gives the one-chip throughput at 1000 residues with two digits, so the last three values at this length are ranges over the rounding of the records. We round the ends of each range outward.
